question: Mr. Gupta is 26 years older than his son Shashank. Shashank's sister Gargi is 4 years younger than Shashank. The age of Mr. Gupta is four times the age of Gargi. What is the age of Shashank?
solution:
Given,

Mr. Gupta is 26 years older than his son Shashank.

Let us consider Shashank age = X

⇒ Age of Mr. Gupta = X + 26 .......... (1)

Shashank's sister Gargi is 4 years younger than Shashank.

⇒ Age of Gargi = X - 4 ........... (2)
